summary: Strike-only for Floralaine's tented wedding at the Cooper Hewitt (Isabel + Mike). About 46 work units: 21 reception tables, 10 aisle meadows + the semi-circle meadow (moved to the band), tent-entrance pots and arch stands, 3 bars, cocktail and after-party bud vases, ~180 candle pieces. Recommend a team of 4 starting at 10:30pm in the tent while guests are at the after party, driving Floralaine's truck back to Glen Ridge and offloading.

logistics_notes: Montclair HQ is closest (Glen Ridge studio is ~10 min from HQ).
Two vehicles: crew in the JS van, one driver brings Floralaine's truck back. Truck is street-parked near the museum: get the exact spot + key contact before 10pm.
Garden entrance on 90th St between Madison + 5th: pull the truck up there to load.
Hard out 2:00am; this plan is off property ~12:45am with a 75-min buffer.
No trash at the venue: all trash rides back to Taylor's driveway.
reasoning: ~46 work units ÷ 5 per person-hour ≈ 9.3 on-site person-hours; +1 for careful packing (keep all mechanics + chicken wire) ≈ 10.5.
Starting at 10:30 instead of 11 (reception ends at 10, guests move inside) gives a 2.25-hr window → 4 people. If the venue won't let us start before 11, it's 5 people or a later finish.
Team of 4 also matches Floralaine's past strikes (Natirar 4, Cooper Hewitt planning assumption 4).
The studio return (drive to Glen Ridge + 35-min offload) is included from the start, since the studio address is on the inquiry and it's Floralaine's truck.
red_flags: Floor plan changed since the first conversation: now 13 rounds + 8 rectangles (was ~20 rounds); 8 rectangles carry 4 pillars + 4–6 votives each, more glass than a round.
Truck location TBD on the street in NYC. A late key handoff could eat the first 15–30 min.
Candle hard goods changed (production book p.12): confirm counts before strike.
NYC night job with security check-in: borderline for the NYC premium. Not applied for a repeat, very organized client, but noted.
